pages.intro:
The Feedback Triage Desk makes sure every piece of customer feedback is read and owned.

- **Log feedback** in the Customer feedback table, or with the Log feedback card.
- **It triages each one** — category and severity — the moment it arrives.
- **You decide** whether it needs a follow-up; a follow-up becomes a WorkQ item for you.

Nothing leaves Workspace.
